title: When the 1‑minute chart looks like a rollercoaster and MMT decides to moon
content:
Me at 3 AM: "Just checking the 1m candle..." 
MMT spikes +21% and my brain goes: ‘Leverage? Nah, just a *tiny* 0.01x for fun.’ 
Reality: My stop‑loss is now a distant memory and my coffee is trembling.
lesson: Set a stop‑loss before you stare at the chart – otherwise the chart will set you on fire.
question: Who else watched MMT explode and then immediately regretted that extra 0.01x? Be honest 👇
